The caveat is that this relied on demand support and credit, not just credibility-enhancing reforms.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.1"]},{"title":"Lula turns down Banco Central pressure, says new chief should look at Brazil, not market","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"2024-07-01","url":"https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/07/01/lula-critica-bc-autonomo-e-diz-que-autoridade-monetaria-nao-atende-populacao.htm","summary":"Lula said he would respect legal central-bank autonomy, but also argued the next chief should look at Brazil rather than “what the financial system says.” This is the key cautionary item: it suggests recurring political pressure on monetary credibility, even if not outright institutional capture.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.2"]}]}
